scripts.test-vanilla-index: bun --hot src/vanilla-javascript/index.ts & bun test ./tests/vanilla-javascript/index*.e2e.ts; kill $(ps aux | grep '[0-9] bun --hot' | awk '{print $2}')
scripts.test-vanilla-broadcast: bun --hot src/vanilla-javascript/broadcast.ts & bun test ./tests/vanilla-javascript/broadcast*.e2e.ts; kill $(ps aux | grep '[0-9] bun --hot' | awk '{print $2}')
scripts.test-htmx-index: bun --hot src/htmx-ws/index.ts & bun test ./tests/htmx-ws/index*.e2e.ts; kill $(ps aux | grep '[0-9] bun --hot' | awk '{print $2}')
scripts.test-htmx-broadcast: bun --hot src/htmx-ws/broadcast.ts & bun test ./tests/htmx-ws/broadcast*.e2e.ts; kill $(ps aux | grep '[0-9] bun --hot' | awk '{print $2}')
scripts.e2e: bun run test-vanilla-index; bun run test-vanilla-broadcast; bun run test-htmx-index; bun run test-htmx-broadcast
